claim: QuanterLab 2026-08-19 (author-run, S&P 500 point-in-time, 20 sealed windows 2006-2025, net of costs): the low-net-issuance book earns 10.58%/yr, Sharpe 0.58, versus the reference index 9.51%/yr, Sharpe 0.54, and beats the earnings-yield book in only 35 of 100 bootstrap paths, which the author calls a statistical tie.
limitations: Author-run platform study of a 30-name low-share-growth long-only S&P 500 book with annual reselection; no borrow or short leg, no 2024+ split, cover-page share counts are not used (weighted shares from filings); second source QuantDecoded (Pontiff-Woodgate 2008 summary) was blocked by a Vercel checkpoint on 2026-09-29 (HTTP 429), so it is claim_only and no number from it is used.
impact_on_spec: Recent large-cap long-only evidence is a tie with the index, so the local test must show a cross-sectional IC on 2024+ with short-leg and cost discipline before any book is built.
